title: No live tenant verification
description: Every Graph, PowerShell, Key Vault, webhook and AI path is exercised only against mocks, simulations or synthetic tenants. No tenant, certificate, vault or paid key was available.
impact: A defect that only appears against a real tenant would ship.
mitigation: Never report live behaviour as verified; keep proof code Simulated/Unverified-live; run the live acceptance checklist in 07-release-gates on a pilot tenant.

title: No multi-user service
description: Collaboration is per-user local SQLite. Two operators cannot share assessments, plans, approvals or audit.
impact: The product cannot claim genuine multi-user collaboration or enterprise adoption.
mitigation: Tracked as SRV-01..SRV-05; documentation states the limitation; next milestone is the self-hosted service and central store.

title: No automated restore
description: A reversal script and stored backup exist, but no restore is executed. Legal hold, disposition and deletion cannot be undone.
impact: A failed deployment cannot be automatically reversed; the release claim is limited to compensation.
mitigation: Keep DEP-03/SAF-02 Partial; require an approved risk exception for destructive phases; design restore against a lab tenant before claiming rollback.

title: Unsigned installer and updates
description: No Authenticode certificate exists, so the EXE, MSI and MSIX are unsigned. The MSI is also framework-dependent.
impact: Windows SmartScreen and enterprise policy may block the installer; update trust is incomplete.
mitigation: Label every artifact unsigned; keep the signing and hash-verification steps in CI; obtain a certificate before a production release.

title: Data Map and Unified Catalog not covered
description: No discovery, assessment or design exists for data sources, scans, domains, data products, lineage or data quality.
impact: Purview coverage is incomplete for the governance persona.
mitigation: Recorded as DSC-15 and Unsupported in 02; scope the workload with a pluggable data-map module.

title: DSPM and AI evidence gap
description: DSPM, DSPM for AI and the Compliance Manager score have no public API used, so those controls fail by default.
impact: Scores can understate a tenant that is actually configured.
mitigation: Controls report as warnings or failures with the reason; never report a false pass; document the manual verification path.

title: Provisioned permissions do not match collector needs
description: The provisioner requests six Graph application permissions; the collectors also rely on role management, Conditional Access and application inventory reads.
impact: A tenant provisioned by the wizard may return partial data for CPM-02/03/05/06/07.
mitigation: Documented in 03; next change adds a manifest-driven request set with verification of each read after consent.

title: Windows 10 and Windows 11 23H2 are out of support
description: General support ended on 2025-10-14 for Windows 10 and 2026-11-10 for Windows 11 23H2; 24H2 Home/Pro ended 2026-10-13.
impact: Hosts left unmanaged will be refused at startup.
mitigation: The lifecycle matrix refuses EOL releases and warns inside 90 days; document the upgrade path in the admin guide.

title: Approval hardening gaps
description: Approvals are not bound to a plan hash, do not expire and have no configurable quorum; a pre-execution drift recheck is absent.
impact: A changed plan could execute under an older approval.
mitigation: Tracked as CHG-03/CHG-04; plan hash and drift recheck are the next change-safety work.

title: No SBOM or plugin signing
description: Releases publish SHA-256 only, and plugins are trusted local code with no manifest or signature.
impact: Supply-chain evidence and plugin least privilege are incomplete.
mitigation: Recorded as SEC-17/SEC-18; add SBOM generation to CI before the next release.

title: Accessibility unverified
description: No accessibility review or automated check exists for the WPF shell.
impact: Users relying on assistive technology may be blocked.
mitigation: Recorded as UX-07; run a keyboard and screen-reader review against the implemented XAML.

title: SQLite page encryption absent
description: Payloads are DPAPI-encrypted but database pages, tenant ids and schema metadata are plaintext.
impact: A local disk compromise can reveal metadata.
mitigation: Documented as a hardening step; full-disk encryption is the interim control.

title: Target .NET 10 LTS
description: .NET 9 reached end of support on 2026-11-10, so all projects moved to .NET 10 (LTS to 2028-11-14).
impact: Modern supported runtime with a three-year horizon.
mitigation: Done; pinned in global.json and CI.

title: Keep WPF rather than rewrite to WinUI 3
description: WinUI 3 could not be built or verified in the delivery environment and the core is UI-agnostic.
impact: Avoids a rewrite and keeps the working shell.
mitigation: Revisit only with a Windows build and design capacity.

title: Consume Graph REST instead of the SDK
description: A typed HttpClient adapter keeps the dependency surface small and is already tested.
impact: Fewer packages and no SDK breaking-change exposure; more hand-written models.
mitigation: Revisit if Graph surface grows substantially.

title: Local privacy gateway is mandatory for every egress
description: Every AI prompt and telemetry payload passes the detector before transmission; defaults are Redact for cloud and Tokenise in settings.
impact: Prevents raw tenant data leaving the host.
mitigation: Tests assert blocked prompts never reach a provider.

title: Pin a patched SQLite native library
description: Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.15 transitively pulled SQLitePCLRaw 2.1.11, which carries GHSA-2m69-gcr7-jv3q (high).
mitigation: SQLitePCLRaw 2.1.14 is pinned and NuGet audit advisories now fail the build.
